notes.title: [v0.1.3] Demo Update - A Moment of Stillness
notes.notes:
New Ending Event: A one-time event now brings quiet closure to the demo - if you're paying attention, you’ll know when it's time to rest.

A subtle prompt now appears to let players know they’ve reached the end - along with a small invitation to leave a review.

New ambient details added to signal that something has shifted… but the forest remains open to exploration.

Thanks to everyone who’s played the demo so far - your feedback has helped shape this update.

notes.title: [v0.1.2] Demo Update: QoL Fixes & Improvements
notes.notes:
Hey everyone - thanks so much for playing the demo and sharing your thoughts! Based on your feedback, here are some of the changes in this update:

The oven can no longer be interacted with unless you’ve learned at least one recipe.

Blocked off some areas that were causing unintended confusion.

Rewrote several item descriptions to make them clearer and less cryptic.

Added subtle hints to better guide players through the core gameplay loop.

Improved key mapping behavior for inventory and interactions.

The Token of Regret now emits a small glow, making it easier to spot in the dark.

More improvements are on the way. Keep the feedback coming - it helps a lot!

notes.title: [v0.1.1] Demo Update - Thanks for Playing + What's Next
notes.notes:
First of all - thank you to everyone who’s tried the demo for Everstill Valley!
Seeing players explore, survive, get lost, and occasionally run screaming into the fog has been incredibly rewarding.



Special thanks to the YouTubers who’ve uploaded long-plays - watching those has given me a lot of insight into what needs work.


Upcoming Improvements (based on feedback):


Crafting UI: The current crafting window is a bit unclear - I’m working on making it more readable and intuitive

Level flow: A few areas are too directionless - I’ll be adding subtle world hints to help players orient without hand-holding

Lighting & fog: Tweaks to improve visibility in key spaces, especially around important POIs

Spawn logic: Fixes to stop the stalker from spawning in weird places (yes, including rooftops…)

Notes: Improvements to visibility and placement of lore notes

Audio levels: Some sound effects are too quiet - adjustments coming to improve balance and atmosphere



This demo is still just a taste of what’s to come - a quiet, rotting forest full of secrets, dread, and slow decay.



If you played and have thoughts, I’d love to hear them. Your feedback shapes this strange little world.



Marcelo
